non_claims: Sugar identity, interglycosidic linkage and glycosylation position (3- versus 3,5-substitution) are not claimed
Acyl groups, unit counts and the anthocyanidin of the chosen hypothesis are recorded with the hypothesis and are not claimed
Flavylium, quinoidal-base and hydrated forms are not distinguished; delphinidin and petunidin glycosides are outside the scaffold list

notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19) pending the author: the P3 proposal drops anthocyanins from v1 (P3-Q17), so this rule is kept but not measured unless the author decides otherwise.

competitors.note: Protonated kaempferol, luteolin and apigenin O-glycosides share the composition and Y0 of the cyanidin and pelargonidin hypotheses.
Emodin O-glycosides share the composition of pelargonidin glycosides.
C-glycosyl flavones such as vitexin share the composition of pelargonidin glycosides.

priors.note: The anthocyanin M is the quinoidal base, so the flavylium cation is matched as [M+H]+ of the listed anthocyanidin plus its units.

Hexose, deoxyhexose and pentose residues and acetyl, malonyl and hydroxycinnamoyl residues occur on anthocyanins, with up to four hexoses and two acyl groups in one compound; the caps of five sugars and two acyl groups are a drafting bound.
